facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of downtown Seattle on Pine Street.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in the heart of downtown Seattle on Pine Street

facts.text: The hotel offers easy access to Pike Place Market and the historic Paramount Theatre.
facts.excerpt: offers effortless access to the city's most iconic landmarks, from the timeless charm of Pike Place Market to the historic Paramount Theatre

facts.text: The hotel is a mile from the Space Needle, reachable on foot or by monorail.
facts.excerpt: Just a mile from the Space Needle, guests can take a scenic stroll or ride the monorail to explore the city's vibrant energy.

facts.text: The Westlake Center light rail station is 1.5 blocks from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: SeaTac Airport to Westlake Center (1.5 blocks from Grand Hyatt Seattle)

facts.text: Rooms and suites have views of downtown Seattle and Elliott Bay.
facts.excerpt: sweeping views of downtown Seattle and Elliott Bay set the scene for relaxation

facts.text: Rooms and suites feature stone entryways, rich wood details and Venetian plaster walls.
facts.excerpt: our luxury hotel rooms and decadent suites feature stone entryways, rich wood details and Venetian plaster walls

facts.text: Bathrooms have Carrara marble accents and deep soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: Get ready in bathrooms with Carrera marble accents and deep soaking tubs

facts.text: Rooms have remote-controlled floor-to-ceiling blackout curtains.
facts.excerpt: open your remote-controlled floor-to-ceiling blackout curtains

facts.text: Bay View rooms are on or above the 22nd floor and look out over Elliott Bay.
facts.excerpt: Delight in sweeping views of Elliott Bay from a lofty hotel room on or above our 22nd floor.

facts.text: The Corner Deluxe Fitness Equipped room has its own fitness area with a Peloton bike, free weights and a yoga mat.
facts.excerpt: A fitness area includes a Peloton bike, free weights and a yoga mat.

facts.text: Club Access rooms include entry to the Grand Club Lounge on the 27th floor.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your stay by opting for a Club Access room, granting you entry to our secluded lounge on the 27th floor.

facts.text: The Grand Club Lounge serves a daily hot breakfast plus refreshments and snacks all day.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a daily hot breakfast and an array of refreshments and snacks all day.

facts.text: The fitness center has a steam room, sauna and jetted tub.
facts.excerpt: Purify your body and mind in the steam room, sauna or jetted tub

facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes, strength training equipment and free weights.
facts.excerpt: Hop on a Peloton bike or get pumped on advanced strength training equipment and free weights.
